verdict.rationale: Algolia's docs describe an official Crawler that extracts web pages into records, plus prebuilt integrations for Shopify, Adobe Commerce, BigCommerce, commercetools, Salesforce B2C Commerce and Zendesk. Algolia also says it manages schedules, retries and transformations from the dashboard without deploying code, so a founder can skip building an indexing pipeline. Community praise for DocSearch on docs sites as needing zero maintenance offers some independent support. Missing for 10: in-depth crawler configuration documentation (only overview snippets are present), any evidenced connectors for databases or data warehouses beyond the commerce/support platforms, and hands-on reports that explicitly describe using the Crawler.
